cues: An energy audit can identify potential savings.
But finding an opportunity does not mean
a factory can immediately invest in it.
Engineers still need to examine equipment data,
estimate repair costs, and prepare evidence for management.
We want to make that process easier to review.
our proposed tool for industrial energy investment decisions.
sentences.tts: Meet Energy Action Bankable, our proposed tool for industrial energy investment decisions.

cues: Engineers enter operating data and compare improvement scenarios
the estimated electricity savings reach sixty thousand kilowatt-hours annually.
With the assumed costs, simple payback is two years.
Every calculation keeps its assumptions and supporting evidence visible.
We also plan to use AI to extract audit findings,
while engineers remain responsible for validating the data.
We are currently at the idea stage.
Through MAJU, we aim to test this workflow with industrial users
and measure whether it improves investment preparation.
